items.title: Eminem’s Publisher Eight Mile Style Sues Suno Over Allegations of Copyright Infringement
items.summary: Eminem’s publishing company, Eight Mile Style, has now filed litigation against Suno for allegedly reproducing their copyrighted works without permission or compensation. Digital Music News was given a first look at the complaint. Eight Mile Style, Eminem’s publishing company that owns or controls the exclusivity to hi…

items.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises Slaps Suno With Copyright & NIL Suit, Says the Platform Was ‘Always Meant to Replace the Artists Whose Works and Identities Were Being Unlawfully Copied’
items.summary: Another day, another AI infringement lawsuit – this time against Suno, which is accused of infringing a number of Elvis Presley copyrights as well as the King of Rock’s name, image, and likeness (NIL) rights. Plaintiffs including Elvis Presley Enterprises, Raleigh Music Publishing, and a subsidiary of Elvis IP owner Au…

items.title: Suno sued by Elvis Presley rights-owners and Eight Mile Style
items.summary: The flow of copyright-infringement lawsuits aimed at AI-music service Suno isn’t letting up yet. Two new legal actions have been added to the pile: from a group of Elvis Presley rights-owners and Eminem publisher Eight Mile Style. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Suno argues that judge should throw out musician’s publicity rights lawsuit
items.summary: Suno is fighting several music industry lawsuits, but one stands out - filed by musician Jason Isbell - because it accuses the AI company of infringing publicity rights by connecting artist names to musical styles in the back-end. Suno has responded to that lawsuit, urging the judge to dismiss it

items.title: Flo Milli and Sony Music Beat ‘Never Lose Me’ Infringement Lawsuit on a Critical Technicality — Absence of a Signed License Agreement Deemed ‘A Fatal Defect’
items.summary: A federal court has once again dismissed artist and songwriter Shamar Deal’s “Never Lose Me” infringement lawsuit against Flo Milli and Sony Music – this time with prejudice, meaning it cannot be refiled. Judge André Birotte Jr. just recently granted the defendants’ dismissal motion without leave to amend, after Deal s…

items.title: Suno AI Music Generator Sued Again For Copyright Infringement
Elvis Presley and Eminem rights holders sue Suno over alleged copyright infringement
Robbie Williams speaks out on ‘disgusting’ plagiarism lawsuits
items.summary: If you’ve heard Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘take me home (4 christmas)’ single, you may have noticed some similarities to Robbie Williams’ 2012 hit ‘Candy’. Is he going to demand a credit, royalties or even sue her? Nope. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Eminem song publisher seeks $41M in copyright lawsuit vs. AI platform
Meta Employees ‘Interacted’ With Pirated Copies of Adult Films, Filing Shows
items.summary: A newly unredacted court filing shows that Meta’s internal investigation found several employees who appear to have interacted with Strike 3’s adult films. The adult content producers say these were torrented copies listed in their lawsuit, but Meta says there is no evidence of torrenting. The company also stresses tha…

items.title: Music industry intervenes in Open AI’s big legal battle with newspapers and authors
items.summary: All of the US music industry’s copyright lawsuits against AI companies swing on whether or not AI training is fair use under US law. A big legal battle involving authors, newspapers and Open AI also centres on fair use, and the music industry has now intervened in that case via an amicus brief

tip.title: Voz clonada: el derecho en juego suele no ser el copyright
tip.body: Imitar la voz de un artista con IA rara vez es infracción de copyright de la canción; el reclamo típico va por derechos de imagen, voz y publicidad, que varían mucho entre jurisdicciones.

tip.title: Cloned vocals: copyright is usually not the issue
tip.body: Mimicking an artist's voice with AI is rarely a copyright infringement of the song itself; claims typically run through name, image, voice and publicity rights, which vary widely by jurisdiction.
